title: A line with only a title shows the title alone in the Customer Invoice report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is off (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, titled "Oil change" with no description.
  • Have line 1 completed with no tech story, and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Reports, then Export Reports in the Reports left menu, with the Export Report dialog open.
custom_steps:
1. Pick Customer Invoice in the Report Name list.
  2. Set the date range to today.
  3. Click Download.
  4. Open the downloaded file in Google Sheets.
  5. In an empty cell, enter =LEN() with line 1's ItemDescription cell inside the brackets.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer Invoice is picked in Report Name.

Step 2:

  • The date range shows today's date.

Step 3:

  • A Customer Invoice file downloads.

Step 4:

  • In line 1's row (work order 1's invoice A) the ItemDescription cell reads exactly "Oil change".
  • There is no hyphen and no space after the title.

Step 5:

  • The cell shows 10 (the title's 10 characters), so nothing is added and nothing trails after the last word.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R3: “A separator appears only between two segments that are both present. A line with no description joins the title straight to the narrative. A line with no narrative ends after the description. A line with neither carries the title alone. In every case there is no trailing separator and no trailing space. A segment made only of spaces counts as absent.”
  • S3-R6a: “A narrative is absent legitimately, not only exceptionally. The organization setting Administration, Work Order Settings, Require Tech Story governs whether the completion gate gets in the way, so a shop with it switched off invoices completed lines with no narrative as a matter of course. Shops created since the setting was introduced (June 2025) start with it off; shops that existed then started with it on. Each shop keeps the value it has set, and this change does not touch it.”
  • Key Decisions: “A spaced hyphen joins the segments, and appears only between two segments that are both present. The separator is a space, a hyphen, a space. A line with no description and no narrative carries the title alone. A line with no narrative ends after the description, with no trailing separator and no trailing space. Rejected: stacking the three on separate lines to mirror the printed invoice exactly. QuickBooks Online does hold line breaks, but Intuit documents that a CSV import merges them back into one line, so the shape would not survive every route into the books.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
